body.x: LAS VEGAS, USA (AVING Special Report on 'CES 2008') -- <Visual News> LG showcased the newest product line-ups for 2008 including phones and accessories that feature the latest touch screen technology, advanced music and TV capabilities, and Bluetooth technology during 2008 CES.
LG Mobile Phones has been won multiple 2008 CES 'Innovations Awards' this year for its handsets, including the Voyager, the Venus and the Muziq by LG.
